name: 48801 · Alma, MI
findings: ZIP 48801 (Alma) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48801 (Alma) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48801 (Alma) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
